New chunk 12 ('Back to the map, one last time') opens with a positional-looking callback ('The map at sitting 2 had an edge nobody explained') but unpacks it immediately and richly in the same paragraph (dashed line, THE TEAM label, the italic soil-line quote) — verified the referent is real: lectures/the-whole-map.md (Module 2's included lecture) carries the identical THE TEAM/dashed-line SVG and the exact quoted line 'a move counts when it crosses the wall' (the-whole-map.md line 84/161).
